items.explanation: Every v1 requirement maps to exactly one phase. It is an error.
items.title: Requirement not mapped to a phase

items.explanation: Phase and plan depends_on are acyclic and point at earlier ones only. It is an error.
items.title: Dependency cycle or forward dependency

items.explanation: A phase has 2–5 success criteria. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Phase success criteria out of range

items.explanation: Phase numbers are continuous; an inserted phase sits between its neighbours. It is a warning.
items.title: Phase numbers not continuous

items.explanation: An out_of_scope requirement has a reason. It is an error.
items.title: Out-of-scope requirement has no reason

items.explanation: A milestone completes only with a passing (or accepted) audit. It is an error.
items.title: Milestone completes without a passing audit

items.explanation: A timestamp field holds an RFC 3339 UTC time (every authored ts field is a str that matches). It is an error.
items.title: Timestamp is not RFC 3339 UTC

items.explanation: A repository has one project (the kernel keeps `singleton` as metadata only). It is an error.
items.title: More than one project

items.explanation: A context has canonical refs (missing_required_field and non_empty under one code). It is an error.
items.title: Context has no canonical refs

items.explanation: A phase spec meets its ambiguity gates. It is an error.
items.title: Phase spec exceeds its ambiguity gates

items.explanation: A locked requirement has a falsifiable acceptance. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Locked requirement is not falsifiable

items.explanation: A research open question is resolved by a decision before planning. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Open research question unresolved

items.explanation: A package in research has a legitimacy verdict. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Package without a legitimacy verdict

items.explanation: A phase has at most one context, phase spec, discussion log and research, and the project at most one research. It is an error.
items.title: More than one context, spec, log or research

items.explanation: Every requirement of a phase is in at least one of its plans. It is an error.
items.title: Phase requirement in no plan

items.explanation: A plan of a phase names at least one requirement (a quick plan names none). It is an error.
items.title: Plan names no requirement

items.explanation: An auto, tdd or tracer task has files and a verify (action and done are required fields). It is an error.
items.title: Task is missing a required field

items.explanation: A plan has at most 3 tasks (4 warns). It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Plan has too many tasks

items.explanation: Plans of one wave share no path in files_modified ∪ files_deleted; under compat that wave runs sequentially. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Same-wave plans overlap on files

items.explanation: A task's files are among its plan's files_modified. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Task file outside the plan's files

items.explanation: Auto_select and answer.option name one of the checkpoint's options, option names are unique, and each checkpoint kind has its fields. It is an error.
items.title: Checkpoint option or fields invalid

items.explanation: A one_way task follows a decision checkpoint of its plan, or names the decision that settles it in reversibility.settled_by. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: One-way task without a decision or a settled_by

items.explanation: A plan has a truth and an artifact. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Plan lacks a truth or an artifact

items.explanation: Every trackable decision of a planned phase's context (origin context) is cited by one of its plans. It is an error.
items.title: Context decision cited by no plan

items.explanation: The plan achieves its phase goal, keeps to scope and contradicts no settled decision. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Plan does not achieve its phase goal

items.explanation: No task action reduces scope ("for now", "simplified", "v1"). It is an error.
items.title: Task action reduces scope

items.explanation: Key links are wired between artifacts the plan names. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Key links not wired

items.explanation: Each task has an automated verify or a wave-0 item (Nyquist). It is an error.
items.title: Task without an automated verify or a wave-0 item

items.explanation: Data contracts between plans match (requires / provides). It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Data contracts between plans mismatch

items.explanation: The plan follows the project's agent instructions and the mapped patterns. It is a warning.
items.title: Plan ignores agent instructions or mapped patterns

items.explanation: The post-planning gap report finds nothing open. It is a warning.
items.title: Post-planning gaps open

items.explanation: The plan-check verdict is fresh before execution. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Plan-check verdict is stale

items.explanation: A prohibition with verification test names a test. It is an error.
items.title: Prohibition names no test

items.explanation: A task's verify command names paths that exist. It is an error.
items.title: Verify command names a missing path

items.explanation: A coupling_justified item names a peer of the same phase and wave: the applied exemption is reported as an advisory. It is information.
items.title: Justified coupling between plans

items.explanation: A plan has fewer than 5 tasks. It is an error.
items.title: Plan has five or more tasks

items.explanation: A plan is named <phase>-<NN> in its phase, and by its quick id YYMMDD-xxx without one. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Plan not named after its phase

items.explanation: A task's verify command runs in a dynamic or outside-the-project directory, or its package.json is unreadable or has no such script. It is a warning.
items.title: Verify command not checked

items.explanation: Each task's verify commands name their failing direction (fails_when), one statement per automated. It is an error.
items.title: Verify command names no failing direction

items.explanation: A summary's requirements_completed equals its plan's requirements. It is an error.
items.title: Summary requirements differ from the plan's

items.explanation: A halted summary says why. It is an error.
items.title: Halted summary says nothing why

items.explanation: A tdd task's GREEN commit descends from a RED test commit, by its recorded ancestry, or by time when it was recorded without ancestry (the RED run's failure is not checked; a warning, as the order cannot be repaired after the fact). It is a warning.
items.title: GREEN commit that descends from no RED commit (green_before_red)

items.explanation: The TDD review checkpoint ran after execution. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: TDD review checkpoint did not run

items.explanation: A phase that changed an ORM's schema files records its database push in a summary or a commit subject, once it has run. It is an error.
items.title: Schema changed with no database push recorded

items.explanation: The context the plan was written against has not drifted (the context_digest a research, spec or validation recorded differs from the context's current digest). It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Context drifted since the plan was written

items.explanation: Every task of a complete plan has a recorded commit (a manual task is exempt). It is a warning.
items.title: Task has no commit

items.explanation: A deliverable's checks pass, or a person judged it and gave a rationale (a check no report speaks of is not judged). It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Deliverable checks neither pass nor are human-judged

items.explanation: The verifier's verdict on each truth, artifact and key link is fresh. It is an error.
items.title: Verifier verdict is stale

items.explanation: An explicit truth is verified only with a passing test recorded for it. It is an error.
items.title: Explicit truth verified without a passing test

items.explanation: An override names who accepted the truth and when (by and at). It is an error.
items.title: Override lacks its author or date

items.explanation: More than three overrides in a phase. It is a warning.
items.title: More than three overrides in a phase

items.explanation: Debt markers (TBD, FIXME, XXX) in the files a plan modifies name an issue on the same line. It is an error.
items.title: Debt marker without an issue

items.explanation: Every settled decision maps to something shipped. It is a warning.
items.title: Settled decision maps to nothing shipped

items.explanation: A skipped UAT test has a reason and an issue has the person's report. It is an error.
items.title: UAT evidence that cannot pass

items.explanation: A planned phase whose research asks for a validation has one, approved before its verification. It is a warning, and an error under gsd-strict.
items.title: Phase lacks a validation it needs

items.explanation: A phase ships only when its verification passed (a gate code of complete_milestone and /gsd-ship). It is an error.
items.title: Phase shipped before verification passed

items.explanation: No broken window is open at ship. It is an error.
items.title: Broken window open at ship

items.explanation: A resolved window cannot be waived or fixed again (waiver and fixed_at are never both set). It is an error.
items.title: Resolved window changed again

items.explanation: No refactor deviation window is recorded while workflow.windows_enforce is off. It is a warning.
items.title: Refactor window recorded while enforcement is off

items.explanation: A complete requirement traces to a task, a commit and a passing test. It is an error.
items.title: Complete requirement without a traced passing test

items.explanation: A stale verdict blocks every workflow step. It is an error.
items.title: Stale verdict blocks the workflow

items.explanation: Active plans of different workstreams share no path in files_modified ∪ files_deleted. It is an error.
items.title: Active plans of different workstreams overlap

items.explanation: The integration checker's verdict on a milestone audit is fresh. It is an error.
items.title: Integration verdict is stale
